posts.title: Our own office, audited first
posts.body:
Before checking anyone else, we checked ourselves. On 23 October 2026 SKULL.ORG audited the 20 website previews our studio hosts for Indian clinics and restaurants: no leaked keys, no scripts loaded from unknown sites, no forms sending data elsewhere, and every preview hidden from search engines.

This week our weekly self-audit of our own machines and repositories found nothing serious, and every action SKULL.ORG takes is written to an append-only log that is checked for tampering.

posts.title: SKULL.ORG is open
posts.body:
SKULL.ORG is the new defensive security desk of adris.tech. We check code, websites and cloud setups for the problems that cost small businesses the most, and we only ever check what its owner has asked us to check, in writing.

While we earn trust, the first checks are free. Ask through the contact page and we will reply with exactly what we would check and how.
